meta.title: 平时练的时候就容易鼓肚子，记得这样操作❗
meta.title_en: Your Belly Puffs Out When You Train? Do This Instead
meta.topic: 健身教学 · 腹部训练

scenes.title_en: The Mistake: Belly Puffing Means Stop
scenes.context: 做仰卧抬腿时，如果腹部明显隆起，说明没练到腹，大概率腰也代偿了。这种请停止。语域：健身教学，先纠错。
sentences: 做仰卧抬腿的动作时，腹部明显隆起，像这种请停止。
If your belly visibly puffs out during lying leg raises, stop right there.
puffs out（隆起）；lying leg raises（仰卧抬腿）
没练到腹，大概率腰也是代偿的。
Your abs aren't working — your lower back is probably compensating.
compensate（代偿）
这样练反而伤腰。
Training this way actually hurts your lower back.
hurts your back（伤腰）
paraphrase: 隆起 → puff out / bulge out
代偿 → compensate / take over the load
scenes.speak: If your belly visibly puffs out during lying leg raises, stop right there. Your abs aren't working — your lower back is probably compensating. Training this way actually hurts your lower back.

scenes.title_en: The Fix: Cushion Your Lower Back With a Small Ball
scenes.context: 用一个瑜伽小球垫高腰底，呼气先收紧腹部，摸起来是硬硬的，一直保持，在这个基础上再做抬腿。语域：健身教学，操作口令。
sentences: 可以用一个瑜伽小球，垫高腰底。
Use a small yoga ball to cushion your lower back.
cushion（垫高）
呼气，先收紧腹部，摸起来是硬硬的。
Exhale and tighten your abs first — they should feel firm to the touch.
firm to the touch（摸起来硬硬的）
一直保持，在这个基础上做抬腿。
Hold it the whole time, then do the leg raises on top of that.
hold it（保持）
paraphrase: 垫高腰底 → cushion the lower back / support the lower back
摸起来硬 → firm to the touch / hard when you poke it
firm to the touch · hard to poke
scenes.speak: Use a small yoga ball to cushion your lower back. Exhale and tighten your abs first — they should feel firm to the touch. Hold it the whole time, then do the leg raises on top of that.

scenes.context: 在这个基础上做抬腿，呼气时抬腿，下落时吸气，保持腹部持续收紧。语域：健身教学，呼吸口令。
sentences: 这个基础上做抬腿，呼气。
On that foundation, do the leg raise on the exhale.
on the exhale（呼气时）
下落实吸气。
Inhale as you lower the legs.
lower the legs（下落）
腹部一直保持收紧。
Keep your abs tight the entire time.
keep tight（保持收紧）
paraphrase: 呼气时抬腿 → raise on the exhale / lift as you breathe out
全程收紧 → keep tight the entire time / stay braced
scenes.speak: On that foundation, do the leg raise on the exhale. Inhale as you lower the legs. Keep your abs tight the entire time.

scenes.title_cn: 收尾：有效改善腹直肌分离
scenes.title_en: Closing: Helps Diastasis and Core Pressure
scenes.context: 这个方法对改善腹直肌分离、悬垂腹、腹内压过大都很有效果。关键是把呼吸和核心收紧配合起来。语域：健身教学，效果总结。
sentences: 对改善腹直肌分离，很有效果。
It's very effective for improving diastasis recti.
diastasis recti（腹直肌分离）
对悬垂腹、腹内压过大，也都很有效果。
It also works well for a saggy belly and high intra-abdominal pressure.
works well for（对…有效）
核心是呼吸配合收紧。
The key is pairing your breath with core tightening.
pairing breath with（呼吸配合）
paraphrase: 腹直肌分离 → diastasis recti / separated ab muscles
呼吸配合 → pair breath with / coordinate breathing and
scenes.speak: It's very effective for improving diastasis recti. It also works well for a saggy belly and high intra-abdominal pressure. The key is pairing your breath with core tightening.

practice: If your belly puffs out during leg raises, your lower back is compensating.
Use a small yoga ball to cushion your lower back.
Raise on the exhale and inhale as you lower the legs.
It's very effective for improving diastasis recti and saggy belly.
pitfalls: The belly is big when I train.
Your belly puffs out when you train.
「鼓肚子」用 puff out / bulge，不是 belly is big。
The waist is doing the work.
「腰代偿」用 lower back is compensating，比 waist is doing the work 更准确。
Put a ball under the waist.
Use a small yoga ball to cushion your lower back.
「垫腰底」是 cushion/support the lower back。
The muscles of the belly are separated.
「腹直肌分离」的专业词是 diastasis recti。
shifts: 用 puff out（鼓出）、compensate（代偿）、hurts your back（伤腰）具体描述
用 firm to the touch（摸起来硬）、stay braced（保持绷紧）、squeeze（夹紧）
用 diastasis recti（腹直肌分离）、intra-abdominal pressure（腹内压）、improve（改善）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：仰臥→仰卧、瑜伽小球、腰底、代长→代偿、腹直肌分离、悬垂腹、腹内压、下落实习气→下落时吸气等。
